modelingNotes: Exact identity: complete body/light block assembly (fixing collar + light block with integral LED), Harmony XB4 metal, red, 24 V AC/DC. Catalog DIA5ED2121212EN p.86/PDF p.88 lists row Red = ZB4BVB4, supply '24 z' (50/60 Hz). Manufacturer prints the reference without the job's presentation hyphen as ZB4BVB4; ZB4-BVB4 and ZB4BVB4 are the same product.

ZB4BVB4 is the electrical body/light block only. The colored plain lens head ZB4BV043 is a separate order: catalog p.66/PDF p.68 shows complete pilot light XB4BVB4 = ZB4BVB4 + ZB4BV043. No lens, no contacts and no BA9s bulb holder are included in this order code.

Terminal identity from Schneider product data sheet ZB4BVB4 (RS mirror, https://docs.rs-online.com/205f/0900766b816e95e4.pdf, 'Product data sheet Characteristics ZB4BVB4', May 9 2023): field 'Terminals description ISO n°1 (X1-X2)PL' gives exactly two supply terminals marked X1 and X2. Screw clamp terminals, <= 2 x 1.5 mm² with cable end, >= 1 x 0.22 mm² without; torque 0.8...1.2 N·m.

Ratings (datasheet, EN/IEC 60947-5-1): [Us] 24 V AC/DC at 50/60 Hz; supply limits 19.2...30 V DC and 21.6...26.4 V AC; current consumption 18 mA; steady signalling; [Ui] 600 V (pollution degree 3); [Uimp] 6 kV; protected red LED; service life 100000 h; -40...70 °C. Device is AC/DC universal, so voltage_type is deliberately omitted on terminals; only the exact 24 V nominal is asserted for circuit-intent comparison.

The 'light' load spans X1-X2 through the LED; membership does not join the two nets. No fixed links, jumpers, ganging, contacts, shields or communication ports exist. se.com product page confirms identity; part end-of-sale APR 05 2023, replacement ZB4BVB1 (universal LED) is not substituted.

Coordinator scope: included metal collar/support protective bonding is not proven by Class I classification. No PE screw, automatic panel bond or exhaustive absence of an electrical attachment interface is asserted. Coverage remains partial.

Exact manufacturer ZB4BVB4 PDF dated12 September2026, 8 body-printed lamp diagram;9 rear terminals, was visually reviewed. The two screws are X1 and X2, and the side drawing shows a lamp between them. Its alternate artwork uses generic ZBV-XX/xx V placeholders; use it only for the matching two-terminal body interface, not exact electrical ratings, LED color or production revision. URL: https://www.se.com/au/en/product/download-pdf/ZB4BVB4

connectionCoverage.notes: Both documented lamp supply clamps X1 and X2 are represented. The included metal fixing collar/support bonding interface and its installed continuity remain unresolved and unmodeled. No dedicated PE endpoint, automatic panel bond or exhaustive absence of conductive attachments is asserted. Head/lens and added electrical blocks are separate.
